title: Returned Payment Terms for a Homesite Reservation
content:
When a payment toward a Homesite Reservation is returned unpaid (insufficient funds, stop payment or chargeback), the figures below apply according to the premium class of the reservation.

| Premium class | Returned-payment fee (USD) | Calendar days after the returned-payment event to receive replacement funds plus the fee | Returned payments after which only wire or certified funds are accepted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | 35.00 | 3 | 1 |
| Corner Homesite | 35.00 | 3 | 1 |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 35.00 | 3 | 1 |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 35.00 | 2 | 1 |
| Water-View Homesite | 35.00 | 2 | 1 |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 35.00 | 2 | 1 |

## Basis questions

**What is the fee charged when a payment comes back unpaid?** The returned-payment fee of 35.00 for every class.

**How long does the buyer have to make good?** Replacement funds plus the returned-payment fee must be received within the calendar days in the third column, counted after the returned-payment event: 3 days for Interior, Corner and Cul-de-Sac Homesites and 2 days for Greenbelt, Water-View and Golf-Frontage Homesites.

**When are only wire or certified funds accepted?** Once the reservation has had the number of returned payments in the last column, which is 1 for every class.
